note: Family-owned park on North End Road in Avon village, Hatteras Island, walking distance to the ocean beach, the Avon pier and Pamlico Sound; no pool. Directory listings (not the operator) describe about 57 full-hookup sites with cable and Wi-Fi, 30/50 amp, RVs to 40 ft, plus a few tent sites. Its own website is down; phone from its Google listing. Hatteras Island is reached only by NC 12 across Pea Island, which ocean overwash closes in storms: visitors were evacuated and barred from October 16, 2026 (Dare County). --Claude
summary: The operator's website is dead (an nginx 403 page since at least November 2025), so there is no operator rate or booking page. Google Maps: 'Sands of Time Campground', 40523 North End Rd, Avon, 4.2 stars / 115 reviews, phone 252-995-5596 (matches), so presence passes via Google and price via RV Life's $$ tier. Recorded a temporary closure: Dare County's visitor evacuation of Hatteras Island (since 2026-10-16, NC 12 closed, visitor entry prohibited). Cleared directory-only hookups, max rig length and Wi-Fi; note rewritten to say where those details come from.
flags: Dead website: https://www.sandsoftimecampground.com serves an nginx '403 Forbidden' page (cached copy last modified 2025-11-12) on every path; Google Maps still links it. No other operator page or booking engine found. Presence met only via Google Maps: 4.2 stars / 115 reviews, phone 252-995-5596, 40523 North End Rd, Avon.

No posted 2024+ operator rate (directory listings show $54 full hookup, undated). Price indicator is only RV Life's $$ tier; within 12 km of the Cape Hatteras gateway, so the US$50 gate would be lifted anyway. Family has not stayed here.

Temporary storm closure recorded from Dare County, not from the park: darenc.gov on 2026-10-22 says NC 12 is closed between the Marc Basnight Bridge and Rodanthe and 'visitor entry is prohibited' on Hatteras Island. Needs a re-check soon (as Cape Hatteras KOA, 15456).
